name: One Button Games 5-in-1 Vol. 8
summary:
5-in-1 pack of fast-paced games which are controlled with a single button. Widescreen!

Pump Press
You control a robot that is constantly moving forward. Your goal is to pump the balloons that are coming towards you by shooting them. If you shoot a balloon 4 times, it will pop. Press a button to shoot and hold a button to go faster. The balloons will remain behind you once they pass you and deflate again. The enemy will push all deflated balloons to the left border. You score points for every balloon that hits the border. To score more points, chain up the balloons.

Cast N
You control a fishing rod and score points by catching blue fish and avoiding red fish. The water level is constantly rising. Catching blue fish raises your score and lowers the water level while catching red fish raises the water level and decreases your score.

Hopping P
Your goal is to jump in both directions and avoid the red obstacles on the field that appear and move towards the edge, where they bounce back and fly back. Move to the sides, dodging moving obstacles. A yellow bonus object may also appear, which allows you to score points by touching red moving objects. This mode is active for a limited amount of time, after which you again need to avoid obstacles while waiting for the bonus object to appear.

Foot Laser
Your goal is to run forward and avoid enemies. There are 2 types of enemies: those that move on the ground and in the air. Hold the button to jump, press twice for a second jump, and press three times for a quick landing. The score is added when the laser touches enemies that spawn randomly.

Laser Fortress
Your goal is to hit with a laser red enemies, without touching blue one. You`ve got point by hitting enemies. Blue objects can run foward, between the enemies, you must to control your laster and try not to hit such objects.
